event_summary: A yellow mug and a blue rectangular block on a black circular platform change visible orientation while their wall shadows change shape and position.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a yellow mug on a black circular platform in front of a wall lit by a bright circular beam. At the start the mug handle is visible on the left side and a large dark mug-shaped shadow appears on the wall to the left. Over time the mug's visible orientation changes, the handle moves out of view and later appears on the right side, and a blue upright rectangular block becomes visible beside the mug. The dark silhouettes on the wall shift and change shape, including mug-shaped and rectangular-block-shaped shadows.

reasons: The mug, platform, wall, light patch, tabletop, cable, and wall shadow are visible.
The video begins with the orientation-changing process already underway or not preceded by a separate still setup.
